# Butan Solar

> Solar EPCC contractor in Malaysia for commercial, industrial and residential rooftop PV. Operated by Butan Construction Sdn Bhd (established 1996, CIDB Grade 7) trading as Butan Solar; Butan Solar Sdn Bhd SSM 202501046131 (1647539-M). SEDA Registered PV Service Provider and Registered Photovoltaic Investor; Suruhanjaya Tenaga Class A electrical contractor.

## Key facts
- Cost rule of thumb: a right-sized low-voltage system costs about 18× the client's monthly electricity bill, or about RM1,100 per panel installed.
- Yield rule of thumb: one panel offsets about RM1 of electricity per day in Malaysia.
- Payback: about 3–4 years outright; GITA and Capital Allowance can recover up to ~38% of system cost through tax.
- Delivery models: Outright purchase; Zero CapEx power purchase agreement (client buys solar electricity from RM0.475/kWh, no upfront cost); bank loan.
- Safety position: DC arcs do not self-extinguish; substandard MC4 connectors and DC cables are a leading cause of rooftop solar fires; firefighters cannot safely spray a live DC array. Butan Solar uses genuine Stäubli MC4 connectors, JJ-Lapp/Helukabel DC cable, AFCI-equipped inverters, and specifies Fonrich rapid shutdown devices (BOMBA-recommended).
- Equipment: LONGi Hi-MO 7 615 W panels (25-year performance warranty); Huawei or Solis inverters (10-year warranty); Butan-fabricated mounting (15-year warranty); 2-year defect liability; 1–2 years complimentary O&M.
- Policy: Solar ATAP replaced NEM 3.0 in January 2026 — no quota, 10-year tenure; homes capped at 5 kWac single-phase / 15 kWac three-phase.
